metadata.description: Tired, patient breathing with a small glance.

metadata.description: Soft crescent eyes, a pleased nod and open hands.

metadata.description: Anticipation squat, fist pump, two-foot hop and a soft landing.

metadata.name: Sad
metadata.description: Slow sag, drooping eyes and heavy arms.

metadata.name: Angry
metadata.description: Planted stance, clenched hands and a short foot stamp.

metadata.name: Confused
metadata.description: Alternating head tilts, raised brow and a questioning hand.

metadata.name: Searching
metadata.description: Hand above the screen, scanning gaze and a careful lean.

metadata.name: Sassy
metadata.description: Side-eye, raised palm and a dismissive wrist sweep.

metadata.name: EyeRoll
metadata.description: Look away, eyes sweep up, followed by a tired shrug.

metadata.name: RudeFlipOff
metadata.description: Anticipate, raise hand, extend finger, hold, retract and settle.

metadata.name: Wave
metadata.description: Open-palm wave with a relaxed return.

metadata.name: Revived
metadata.description: Straighten, smile, lift both palms and settle with relief.
